typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		ProviderID as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string,
		AUTHTYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(length(MemberID) > 11, disjoint: true) ~> CheckFieldLength@(FieldTooLong,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CheckFieldLength@FieldTooLong derive(Errors = (iif(length(MemberID) > 11, 'Member ID Too Long, ', ''))) ~> AddErrorsField
AddErrorsField derive(ErrorsWithoutTrailingComma = left(Errors, length(Errors) - 2)) ~> AddErrorsFieldWithoutTrailingComma
AddErrorsFieldWithoutTrailingComma sink(input(
		ProviderID as string,
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AUTHTYPE as string,
		Errors as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ProviderID,
		MemberID,
		AuthID,
		AUTHTYPE,
		Errors = ErrorsWithoutTrailingComma,
		AuthStatus,
		UrgentIndicator)) ~> ErrorFlatFile
